title: Agiloft and Legora integrate to bring data-first contract intelligence into AI-powered work for enterprises
summary: Strategic partnership integrates Agiloft’s data-first platform with Legora, bringing deep analytical insights into end-to-end contract workflows.
body_markdown:
[Agiloft](https://www.agiloft.com/) , a global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM), and[Legora](https://legora.com/) , the agentic operating system for legal work, today announced a strategic partnership to deliver a powerful, streamlined product integration. This collaboration focuses on enhancing the mutual customer experience by pairing Agiloft’s trusted enterprise CLM platform with the Legora environment.


In modern enterprise environments, legal teams frequently navigate fragmented workflows when moving between distinct legal technology applications. By pairing Agiloft’s industry-leading, deeply customizable contract system of record with Legora’s AI platform for legal work, the integration enables users of both platforms to perform contracting and legal work end-to-end. This integration will benefit legal, procurement, sales, and finance professionals who rely on cross-platform data.


Together, Agiloft and Legora will connect data-first contract intelligence with AI-powered legal work, helping in-house teams keep their legal work connected to the agreements, business context, and enterprise workflows that support it:


-


**Contract intelligence across the connected workflow** : Mutual customers will be able to find Agiloft agreements in Legora using plain-language searches and draw on structured contract data, including counterparties, key dates, and obligations. This connection will bring the business context maintained in Agiloft into work performed in Legora.


-


**Legal work connected to enterprise workflows** : Users will be able to save work from Legora directly back to Agiloft as a new version, a separate document, or a replacement for the original, without manual downloads and uploads. Changes, comments, and user-recorded reasoning will help legal, procurement, sales, and finance teams carry review context into subsequent decisions and contract workflows.


-


**Agiloft governance across platforms** : Agiloft permissions will govern which agreements users can retrieve through Legora and whether they can save or overwrite documents in Agiloft, keeping the connected workflow within established document access controls.


“In-house teams have put years into structuring their contracts in Agiloft: the counterparties, the dates, the obligations,” said Bryan Tsao, Chief Product Officer at Legora. “That data should be the starting point for any AI work, not something a lawyer has to re-upload. Bringing it into Legora, and saving the finished work back, means the repository stays the source of truth and Legora does the work on top of it.”


“Legal teams are being asked to move faster using AI and still operate inside the governance frameworks their businesses depend on,” said Jason Barnwell, Chief Product Officer at Agiloft. “This partnership gives mutual customers a connected experience between Agiloft and Legora, so teams can work in the environment they’re already using, while Agiloft continues to provide the structured agreement data and access controls underneath. That is where AI becomes much more useful: when it is grounded in trusted contract data and built into the way legal teams actually work.”


The integration will be rolled out in phases, starting with the availability of Agiloft agreements in Legora. Release timing for subsequent phases will be shared with mutual customers as the rollout progresses.


**About Legora**


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,000 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.


**About Agiloft**


Agiloft is the global value leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM), offering the industry’s only no-code platform with AI on the inside™ to enhance efficiency, cut review times by up to 80%, and accelerate business. Its Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP) transforms contracts into strategic, data-rich assets, integrating with 1,000+ systems to drive decisions and efficiency. Trusted by brands like Alkermes, Balluff, and TaylorMade, Agiloft boasts a 96% renewal rate and 100% satisfaction for implementations. Backed by KKR, JMI Equity, and FTV Capital, Agiloft empowers businesses to drive smarter strategies, faster decision-making and game-changing competitive advantage. Learn more at[www.agiloft.com](https://www.agiloft.com/) .
